top_deficiency_types.title: Provide the appropriate treatment and services to a resident who displays or is diagnosed with dementia.
top_deficiency_types.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Procure food from sources approved or considered satisfactory and store, prepare, distribute and serve food in accordance with professional standards.
Provide and implement an infection prevention and control program.
Provide appropriate care for a resident to maintain and/or improve range of motion (ROM), limited ROM and/or mobility, unless a decline is for a medical reason.
top_deficiency_types.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Ensure drugs and biologicals used in the facility are labeled in accordance with currently accepted professional principles; and all drugs and biologicals must be stored in locked compartments, separately locked, compartments for controlled drugs.
Dispose of garbage and refuse properly.
Honor the resident's right to share a room with spouse or roommate of choice and receive written notice before a change is made.
Give residents notice of Medicaid/Medicare coverage and potential liability for services not covered.
Keep residents' personal and medical records private and confidential.
Provide appropriate care for residents who are continent or incontinent of bowel/bladder, appropriate catheter care,  and appropriate care  to prevent urinary tract infections.
top_deficiency_types.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies
